name: 43607 · Toledo, OH
findings: ZIP 43607 (Toledo) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43607 (Toledo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 43607 (Toledo) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
